name: Sou8
approval: Carl requested the raft concept for eight bamboo, then approved deployment of the resulting image.
processing: Entire approved image resized with Lanczos to the existing 300 x 400 game canvas; WebP quality 80, method 6. No redraw, recolouring, added symbols or crop. Standard 1% bleed and 26-unit corner clipping are applied only by the SVG wrapper.
palette: The blue river, golden sky, green bamboo and brown lashings are preserved as explicitly approved. This is an artwork exception to the set's all-green palette convention for 8s, not a change to Mahjong rules or All Green eligibility.
runtimeFit: Since October 2026 the runtime face is this study with only its picture's box moved, so it crops the whole 1024 × 1536 portrait to the face instead of squeezing it to 3:4. svgSha256 is the study's hash; web/public/tiles/van-gogh/manifest.json records the face's own hash and fit.
sourceAvailability: The repository SVG embeds a game-sized WebP export, not the full-resolution original PNG. The original image is identified by the SHA-256 above.
